gates.title: Performance
gates.environment: GitHub ubuntu-latest (4 vCPU), bwrap; earlier: macOS
observations: verify 1.44–2.31x slower than native in 3/5 held-out cases (historical)

2026-10-31 speed-v1 (preregistered; 5 pinned pure-Python projects x 6 real upstream commits; GitHub ubuntu runner, bwrap): verify --run cold 1.84x the native suite (geometric mean), slower on 24 of 30; the 6 'faster' were verify runs that failed (more-itertools full-suite-failed). Overhead median +0.63 s; reuse 0.20 s. No false assurance, with little power (only 5 of 30 native suites failed, 2 of them contaminated by a harness defect); verify failed natively passing tests in 14 (pyjwt network-denied, more-itertools and humanize unexplained, marshmallow name-matched files)

2026-11-01 profile of the fixed overhead (macOS, Apple Silicon; a 40-test pytest project; not a re-run of speed-v1): a comment-only verify --run spent ~0.68 s of 0.92 s in 18 sequential git subprocesses (35 ms each through Apple's /usr/bin/git launcher stub, 17 ms direct) and ~80 ms importing the mission runtime and provider adapters to build the argument parser. Fixed: the stub is resolved once per process (gitbin.git(): DEVELOPER_DIR, the xcode-select link, else xcode-select -p) and those imports are lazy. verify --run 965 -> 636 ms (comment-only), 1,370 -> 992 ms (behaviour change, full suite), reuse 544 -> 330 ms; Claude hooks ~150 -> 67-81 ms (session-start 324 -> 205 ms). Remaining duplicate git reads are the before/after source-tree checks and are kept. Linux overhead (speed-v1) is not re-measured by this

2026-11-01 speed-v1 run 3 (Amendment 3, a replication stated before the run; GitHub run 41306386452, commit 8cd3afd, different runner CPU): cold 2.23x the native suite (geometric mean), slower on 30 of 30 (run 2: 1.84x, 24 of 30); without more-itertools (measured differently: targeted in run 3, full in run 2) 2.61x vs 2.64x; absolute overhead confounded by the CPU change, not compared. Exit codes agree with the native suite on 23 of 30 (run 2: 16): more-itertools 6/6 and humanize f772e59b now agree, consistent with the 0.11.4/0.11.5 fixes but not isolated by the runs (more-itertools full suite seen passing once); pyjwt 6 (pre-existing, consistent with the denied network) and marshmallow 2fc8207d still disagree, and 2fc8207d still gives two verdicts for one state (cold exit 1, --rerun exit 0); no false assurance, little power (0 of 4 failing native suites, all configuration or collection crashes)

2026-11-01 #65: when verify matches pytest tests by name, the plan names test files under the project's norecursedirs (read from the file pytest would use), so a targeted/full disagreement like marshmallow 2fc8207d is explained in the product; a note only, nothing removed

2026-11-01 Linux profile (scripts/profile_verify.py on GitHub runners, 40-test generated project with its own .venv; profile runs 41340493434 before, 41340833864 after): git was negligible on Linux (18 calls, 0.03 s); the two source-tree snapshots took ~0.62 of 0.70 s (profiled) of a comment-only verify, mostly pathlib relative_to over ~2,000 venv entries (cProfile inflates such code; unprofiled comment-only 0.34 -> 0.23 s on a slower runner). Fixed by carrying relative prefixes (oracle-tested): ratio to the native suite on ubuntu 2.16x -> 1.12x (comment-only), 3.54x -> 2.38x (behaviour change; the sandboxed pytest, ~0.2 of 0.49 s, is now the largest single part; most of that ratio drop is the slower runner's larger native time, absolute 0.55 -> 0.49 s); macOS 2.86x -> 1.71x, 4.17x -> 3.04x. One run per platform, runners differed (native suite +25-32% in the after run), so ratios are reported, not absolute times; speed-v1 not re-run
limits: small, fast pure-Python suites on one runner type; not a general claim

verify still exits 1 on natively passing suites whose failing tests are consistent with the denied network (pyjwt) or are matched by name without verify --record (marshmallow 2fc8207d, whose verdict also flips between a cold run and --rerun: the targeted run names files pytest's norecursedirs skips, the full run does not (RESULTS.md addendum; why the strategy differed is not recorded); a limit until verify --record)
gates.next_action: re-run speed-v1 (a replication amendment) after the snapshot fix; record sandbox_network_suspected, full-suite counts, strategy.reason and the pytest argv in the harness
